name: Preaching The Gospel
overview: Scripture commands believers to actively proclaim the gospel message, emphasizing the urgency of preaching the kingdom of heaven as near and calling all to repentance and faith. Jesus instructs His followers to boldly share what they have heard, making disciples of all nations through teaching and baptism. The reward for those who turn many to righteousness is great, shining like stars forever. This calling extends inclusively, as seen in the acknowledgment of women preaching the gospel, underscoring the shared responsibility of all believers to freely give what they have freely received.
